• Shape the way your words sound

    Adjust the tone and pace of talk-to-text audio with keyboard shortcuts

  • Quick-reply with a few taps

    Keep conversations fluid and fast with AI-powered, quick replies

  • Track non-verbal cues

    Understand speaker sentiment and know who is speaking, typing, or pausing

  • Use any language, almost

    Rylo supports 50+ languages and auto-detects language changes in real time

  • Filter for spam & profanity

    Easily manage out the types of conversations you don’t want

  • Works with your other devices

    Pair Rylo with your hearing aids, cochlear implants, and bluetooth headsets

  • Adjust the caption styles

    Choose how the text of your conversation looks

  • Download the app
